title: Dhawal Shamsher Rana, Durga Prasai to launch ‘Jaya Nepal Party’ - Khabarhub
description: Dhawal Shamsher Rana, Durga Prasai to launch ‘Jaya Nepal Party’  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Former Rastriya Prajatantra Party (RPP) leader Dr. Dhawal Shamsher Rana and medical entrepreneur Durga Prasai are set to register a new political party, the Jaya Nepal Party, with the Election Commission on August 13.

The decision follows a series of discussions between the two leaders, who have agreed on the party’s name, flag and other organizational matters, according to sources involved in the initiative.

Young leader Sagun Lawati of Panchthar is also associated with the new political campaign.

Under the proposed party structure, Rana will serve as the party chair, while a new position of “Supreme Leader” has been created for Prasai.

Rana resigned from the RPP on May 4, giving up even his ordinary membership. He was joined by 183 leaders and cadres, including former RPP Vice Chair Mukund Shyam Giri and former minister Dilnath Giri.

Prasai, meanwhile, has been leading campaigns advocating for the restoration of Nepal as a Hindu state and the monarchy through his “Nation, Nationality, Religion and Culture Protection Campaign.”

The campaign has focused on issues including the economic slowdown, debt burdens faced by bank and microfinance borrowers, increasing youth migration for foreign employment and criticism of the current political system.

Prasai was previously associated with the then CPN (Maoist) before later joining the CPN-UML, where he served as deputy chief of the party’s economic department and became a central committee member.

He eventually left the UML after relations with party chair KP Sharma Oli deteriorated and later aligned himself with the royalist movement.

Prasai has remained a controversial political figure in recent years and has been arrested on multiple occasions over allegations related to his public statements and activities.

title: Mapping India and China’s Clean Energy Trade in South Asia: Sri Lanka and Nepal - CSEP India
description: Mapping India and China’s Clean Energy Trade in South Asia: Sri Lanka and Nepal  CSEP India
publisher.title: CSEP India
full_article:
Sri Lanka’s imports of solar PV components from China have steadily increased, both in absolute terms and as a percentage of total imports, reaching US$ 117 million in 2024. Notably, even during the Sri Lankan financial crisis from 2019 to 2024, when both its forex reserves and the value of its currency declined, the country continued to import an average of US$ 50 million worth of components.

As South Asian countries accelerate their clean energy transitions, they are increasingly relying on imports of clean energy (CE) components. Together with the Bangladesh analysis presented in the first blog, the trends in Sri Lanka and Nepal illustrate how CE trade has evolved and what they could mean for India’s regional interests.

Sri Lanka’s Clean Energy Imports

Sri Lanka’s imports of solar PV components from China have steadily increased, both in absolute terms and as a percentage of total imports, reaching US$ 117 million in 2024. Notably, even during the Sri Lankan financial crisis from 2019 to 2024, when both its forex reserves and the value of its currency declined, the country continued to import an average of US$ 50 million worth of components (Figure 1). By contrast, imports from India remained negligible for much of the past decade and have only begun to slowly grow since 2023 (Figure 2).

Figure 1: Sri Lanka’s Imports of Solar PV, Wind Turbine and Battery Components From China

Source: UN Comtrade Database: Commodity codes 854140, 854142, 854143, 850231, 850760 (Sri Lanka’s imports from China, Hong Kong SAR, and Macao SAR).

China has also been a major supplier of battery components. However, its share declined between 2017 and 2019, when demand was satisfied through imports from Singapore (2017, 2018), Australia (2017), Japan (2018, 2019), and India (2019) (Figure 3).

Figure 2: Sri Lanka’s Imports of Solar PV, Wind Turbine and Battery Components From India

Source: UN Comtrade Database: Commodity codes 854140, 854142, 854143, 850231, and 850760.

India was an important supplier of wind turbine components between 2014 and 2018 but has since been largely displaced by China, which has maintained a dominant share since 2019 (Figure 2). The recent decline in China’s share since 2022 has been driven by increased imports from other players such as Spain (2023) and Portugal (2024) Figure 3).

Figure 3: Sri Lanka’s Imports of Solar PV, Wind Turbine and Battery Components, Excluding China and India

Source: UN Comtrade Database: Commodity codes 854140, 854142, 854143, 850231, and 850760.

Nepal’s Clean Energy Imports

Between 2014 and 2018, Nepal sourced the majority of its solar PV components from India; however, since 2019, these have been gradually replaced by imports from China. Imports of wind turbine components have remained low, never exceeding US$ 20,000 (Figure 4).

Source: UN Comtrade Database: Commodity codes 854140, 854142, 854143, 850231, and 850760 (Nepal’s imports from China, Hong Kong SAR, and Macau SAR).

Imports of wind turbine components from China stopped in 2015 and were replaced by those from India, which, although small in absolute terms, occasionally accounted for the entirety or a substantial proportion of imports (Figure 4 and Figure 5). Spain was another source of imports during 2015 and 2017, although these never amounted to more than US$ 2,000 (Figure 6).

Figure 5: Nepal’s Imports of Solar PV, Wind Turbine and Battery Components from India

Source: UN Comtrade Database: Commodity codes 854140, 854142, 854143, 850231, and 850760.

Chinese battery component imports have dominated the market since 2014. However, its share has gradually declined since 2020, falling to around 78% by 2024 as imports from South Korea (2023) and India increased (Figure 5 and Figure 6). The dip in the share of Chinese imports in 2018 was supplemented by imports from Japan (Figure 6).

Figure 6: Nepal’s Global Imports of Solar PV, Wind Turbine and Battery Components, Excluding China and India

Source: UN Comtrade Database: Commodity codes 854140, 854142, 854143, 850231, and 850760.

The trends observed show that today China is now the dominant player in CE trade in the region. This was not always the case.

Way Forward

The trends observed show that today China is now the dominant player in CE trade in the region. This was not always the case. Between 2014 and 2024, India played an important role in supplying solar PV components to Nepal and wind turbine components to Sri Lanka. China’s rise to dominance was driven by export-oriented policies such as the Belt and Road Initiative International Green Development Coalition (BRIGC) and the Global Development Initiative. In 2021, these efforts were supplemented by President Xi Jinping’s pledge to fund renewable energy projects instead of coal power plants abroad.

As the energy transition in South Asia becomes increasingly dependent on China, imports will translate into after-sales services, industrial linkages, and increased cooperation on technological standards and financing. Indian manufacturers will find a narrower window for regional exports, and policymakers will consequently find it harder to leverage India’s geographic proximity and trade ties for sustained economic presence.

This is reflective of China’s early focus on CE manufacturing built on strong state support, targeted financial incentives, and the green stimulus introduced following the 2008 financial crisis. These measures resulted in consequent economies of scale and lower production costs. India, by contrast, was unable to develop an equally competitive CE manufacturing ecosystem during the same period. Inadequate and inconsistent incentives, weak policy enforcement, land acquisition challenges, limited industry networks, restricted access to affordable credit, and low demand aggregation are some of the reasons for this lack of competitiveness.

However, today India is gradually strengthening its green manufacturing base. Its recent gains in these markets may be indicative of both improvements in domestic capabilities and a growing desire of South Asian countries to diversify their supply chains, as evidenced by imports from third countries like Spain, Portugal, Japan, South Korea, and Australia.

Nevertheless, countering China’s dominance will be difficult. As the energy transition in South Asia becomes increasingly dependent on China, imports will translate into after-sales services, industrial linkages, and increased cooperation on technological standards and financing. Indian manufacturers will find a narrower window for regional exports, and policymakers will consequently find it harder to leverage India’s geographic proximity and trade ties for sustained economic presence.

To address this, policymakers could explore measures to increase India’s presence in the neighbourhood. Some potential approaches to incentivise the private sector to develop export competitiveness include developing an export-specific CE policy, cooperation on technical standards, preferential trade agreements, and encouraging CE financing in export countries. Future research could examine the feasibility of these and other policy options. In the meantime, India must also continue to strengthen its CE export ecosystem by identifying and building on its comparative advantages, fostering innovation, and achieving greater economies of scale.

title: Fact Check: These videos DON'T show violence against Muslims in Nepal - India Today
description: Fact Check: These videos DON'T show violence against Muslims in Nepal  India Today
publisher.title: India Today
full_article:
Communal violence erupted across Nepal at the end of July after a dispute between Hindu and Muslim groups over religious celebrations. Instances of unrest were reportedly concentrated in Nepal’s southeastern plains.

Videos allegedly showing this violence have since gone viral on social media. In this story, we will debunk two such videos.

BANGLADESH VIOLENCE

This video shows a bearded man tied to a tree and several children slapping him. An X user shared the video with the caption, “Nepal: It's so difficult to be a Muslim in Nepal right now.”

advertisement

Read More

We noticed the Instagram username “MD.SOIMUL” in the viral video. We searched this account and found the longer version of the video shared on July 15. The user, Md Soimul, did not provide any details about the incident. However, we found that the account is based in Bangladesh.

In the longer version of the video, we noticed a mosque with the name Dakshin Vinglabari Jame Masjid written on the wall. We found that the mosque is located in Vinglabari village, Comilla District, in Chittagong Division of Bangladesh.

The visuals on Google Maps Street View match the viral video, proving it is from Bangladesh.

This proves that the viral claim is false.

JAMAAT VERSUS BNP

This video shows a mob brandishing sticks attacking and creating a ruckus in a public place. An X user shared the video with the caption, “Illegal infiltrators are being handpicked and driven out of Nepal, who had been settled there as part of a conspiracy to turn it into Ghazwa-e-Nepal. The government is taking back voting rights from them. Nepal's Hindus are on alert over demographic changes.”

advertisement

Reverse-searching keyframes from the video led us to the Facebook page of AL Madina TV. Here, the video was shared on July 5. According to the account, the video is from Bangladesh’s Gulistan. It shows an attack on Jamaat members by the Bangladesh Nationalist Party.

Subsequent keyword searches led us to reports from Bangladeshi news outlets, including Prothom Alo and The Daily Inqilab, in July. According to them, the Jamaat-e-Islami, the country’s main opposition party, had organised a protest in Dhaka's Gulistan against extortion and encroachment. The protesters were attacked, and around 15 to 20 people were injured. The Jamaat-e-Islami blamed the ruling party, the BNP, for the attack.

Thus, it is clear that both videos are from Bangladesh and have nothing to do with communal violence in Nepal.

- Ends

title: Nepal overruled its own security agencies to cancel Tibetan studies conference under Chinese pressure, officials say - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepal overruled its own security agencies to cancel Tibetan studies conference under Chinese pressure, officials say  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
The Nepal government cancelled a week-long international Tibetan studies conference that had been four years in the planning — overriding its own security agencies’ assessment that the event posed no threat, and reversing a public assurance from Home Minister Sudan Gurung that it would go ahead.

Chief Secretary Govinda Bahadur Karkee, after consultations with Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai, personally called senior Kathmandu University officials and instructed them to stop the event, according to multiple government officials who spoke to Kathmandu Post. The decision was never brought before Cabinet, despite what one minister described as significant foreign policy implications. Officials who spoke to the Post asked to speak on condition of anonymity so they could discuss sensitive decisions without fear of retribution.

“We advised the organisers that it would be better not to hold the event. It could be sensitive, several concerns might arise, and it could pose security risks. So we advised the organisers, in good faith, to cancel the event,” Karkee told the Post, confirming the matter had been discussed.

However, the head of one security agency told the Post that officials had examined the event “from various angles” and, even with “around 18 or 19 days remaining,” had explicitly stopped short of recommending cancellation — choosing instead to continue monitoring. Just days before Karkee’s order, Home Minister Gurung had told journalists from Kantipur that the seminar would not be cancelled, only that participants would face security vetting.

The reversal followed a sustained pressure campaign by Chinese diplomats that intensified once registration closed in June. On July 21, Ambassador Zhang Maoming met Foreign Secretary Rai to discuss the conference; officials familiar with the meeting said Zhang stopped short of directly demanding cancellation but urged Rai to stay “vigilant” about participants who might make pro-Tibet statements.

As the lobbying continued, Venerable Master Yinshun — a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), former vice president of the Buddhist Association of China, and abbot of the Chinese Temple of Nepal — arrived in Kathmandu on July 29. A senior security official said Yinshun discussed the seminar during his visit, which also took him to Lumbini. Following his visit and a separate meeting between Rai and the ambassador, half a dozen Tibetan experts from the Tibetan Policy Institute in India withdrew from the conference.

“Beijing has already become suspicious that the present government is tilted toward the West. The seminar became a test of the government’s neutrality. To assuage China’s concerns, the decision was taken to cancel the event,” another senior government official said.

Organisers of the conference reject the framing that the seminar was sensitive.

“Nepal was selected to host the conference in 2022,” one organiser said. “It is therefore incorrect to suggest that the event was planned only recently. The decision was made four years ago, and a large delegation from several Chinese universities, including Peking University, was expected to participate.”

Around 100 Chinese scholars and experts — including from the China Tibetology Research Centre — had registered to attend the seminar, which was to bring together scholars of Tibetan history, language, culture, art, philosophy and religion. Organisers say they had already agreed to Beijing’s core conditions.

“We had assured the authorities that there would be no pro-Tibet or anti-China activities or statements and that no individuals associated with such activism would be invited. We do not understand why the government is now considering stopping the event,” another organiser said.

A Kathmandu University spokesperson said the institution had repeatedly told the government the conference was “purely an academic exercise” with no pro-Tibet or anti-China agenda.

“There has been immense pressure on us to cancel the event,” the spokesperson said. Kathmandu University has since withdrawn as convener, leaving it to the International Association for Tibetan Studies (IATS) to decide whether — and where — the seminar can still be held.

One organiser linked Beijing’s alarm to a separate flashpoint: protests by Tibetans against China’s new Ethnic Unity Law, which took effect July 1. According to Amnesty International, the law frames “ethnic unity” as a precondition for advancing the Chinese Communist Party’s political agenda, including Xi Jinping Thought. “There have been major protests against China’s new Ethnic Unity Law. That is why Beijing intensified its lobbying and used its influence to prevent any untoward incidents in Kathmandu,” the organiser said.

One high-ranking government official who was aware of the decision told the Post the government should have focused on managing risk rather than cancelling the seminar outright.

Despite the cancellation, a Chinese delegation linked to the seminar is still expected to arrive in Nepal. Jiang Jianguo — a member of the Standing Committee of the CPPCC’s National Committee, vice director of its Ethnic and Religious Committee, and executive vice president of the China Society for Human Rights Studies — is scheduled is set to be accompanied by a five-person delegation, arriving on August 18 for a three-day trip.

The Chinese Embassy in Kathmandu did not respond to the Post’s repeated requests for comment.

“Since we have withdrawn as conveners, it is now up to the IATS to decide where and how the programme will be organised,” said Professor Sagar Sharma, one of the event's chief conveners.

नेपाल सरकार न॑ एक सप्ताह भर चलै वाला अंतर्राष्ट्रीय तिब्बती अध्ययन सम्मेलन क॑ रद्द करी देलकै जेकरा म॑ चारि साल स॑ योजना बनैलऽ गेलऽ छेलै — अपनऽ सुरक्षा एजेंसी केरऽ ई आकलन क॑ ओवरराइड करी क॑ कि ई आयोजन स॑ कोय खतरा नै छै, आरू गृहमंत्री सूडान गुरुंग केरऽ सार्वजनिक आश्वासन क॑ उलटैलकै कि ई आगू बढ़तै ।

मुख्य सचिव गोविन्द बहादुर कार्की, विदेश सचिव अमृत बहादुर राय सँ परामर्श केलाक बाद व्यक्तिगत रूप सँ काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय के वरिष्ठ अधिकारी के फोन क आयोजन रोकबाक निर्देश देलनि, काठमांडू पोस्ट सँ बात करय वाला एकाधिक सरकारी अधिकारी के अनुसार। एक मंत्री न॑ एकरा विदेश नीति केरऽ महत्वपूर्ण प्रभाव के रूप म॑ बतैला के बावजूद ई फैसला क॑ कैबिनेट के सामने कहियो नै लानलऽ गेलै । पोस्ट सं बात करय वाला अधिकारी अपन नाम नहिं बताबय के शर्त पर बात करय लेल कहलखिन्ह जाहि सं ओ बिना प्रतिशोध के डर के संवेदनशील फैसला पर चर्चा क सकय.

कार्की न॑ पोस्ट क॑ बतैलकै कि ई आयोजन नै करलऽ जाय त॑ बेहतर होतै, ई संवेदनशील होय सकै छै, कई तरह के चिंता पैदा होय सकै छै, आरू एकरा स॑ सुरक्षा के खतरा भी पैदा होय सकै छै ।

लेकिन, एक सुरक्षा एजेंसी के प्रमुख न॑ पोस्ट क॑ बतैलकै कि अधिकारियऽ न॑ ई आयोजन केरऽ जांच “विभिन्न कोणऽ स॑” करलकै आरू “करीब १८ या १९ दिन बची गेलऽ छै” के बावजूद भी, स्पष्ट रूप स॑ रद्द करै के सिफारिश करै स॑ कम रुकी गेलऽ छै — एकरऽ बदला म॑ निगरानी जारी रखै के विकल्प चुनलकै । कार्की केरऽ आदेश स॑ कुछ दिन पहलें गृहमंत्री गुरुंग न॑ कान्तिपुर स॑ पत्रकारऽ स॑ कहलकै कि ई गोष्ठी रद्द नै करलऽ जैतै, खाली ई छै कि प्रतिभागी सिनी क॑ सुरक्षा जांच के सामना करना पड़तै ।

चीनी राजनयिकऽ द्वारा लगातार दबाव अभियान के बाद ई उलटफेर करलऽ गेलऽ छै जे जून म॑ पंजीकरण बंद होय गेलऽ छेलै । 21 जुलाई कए राजदूत झांग माओमिंग विदेश सचिव राय स भेंट क सम्मेलन पर चर्चा केलथि; बैठक स॑ परिचित अधिकारियऽ न॑ कहलकै कि झांग न॑ सीधा रद्द करै के मांग करै स॑ काम नै करलकै लेकिन राय स॑ आग्रह करलकै कि वू प्रतिभागी सिनी के बारे म॑ “सतर्क” रह॑ जे तिब्बत समर्थक बयान द॑ सकै छै ।

पैरवी जारी रहलै, पूज्य मास्टर यिनशुन — चीनी जन राजनीतिक परामर्शदात्री सम्मेलन (सीपीपीसीसी) केरऽ राष्ट्रीय समिति के सदस्य, चीन केरऽ बौद्ध संघ केरऽ पूर्व उपाध्यक्ष, आरू नेपाल केरऽ चीनी मंदिर केरऽ मठाधीश — २९ जुलाई क॑ काठमांडू पहुँचलै ।एक वरिष्ठ सुरक्षा अधिकारी न॑ कहलकै कि यिनशुन न॑ अपनऽ यात्रा के दौरान गोष्ठी प॑ चर्चा करलकै, जेकरा म॑ हुनका लुम्बिनी भी ल॑ गेलै । हुनकऽ यात्रा आरू राय आरू राजदूत के बीच अलग-अलग मुलाकात के बाद भारत म॑ तिब्बती नीति संस्थान केरऽ आधा दर्जन तिब्बती विशेषज्ञ सम्मेलन स॑ हटी गेलै ।

एकटा आओर वरिष्ठ सरकारी अधिकारी कहलनि जे, बीजिंग मे पहिने सं शक भ गेल अछि जे वर्तमान सरकार पश्चिम दिस झुकल अछि, सेमिनार सरकार के तटस्थता के परीक्षा बनि गेल, चीन के चिंता के शांत करय लेल एहि आयोजन के रद्द करय के फैसला लेल गेल.

सम्मेलन के आयोजक एहि फ्रेमिंग के खारिज क दैत छथिन्ह जे गोष्ठी संवेदनशील छल.

एकटा आयोजक कहलनि जे, 2022 मे सम्मेलन के आयोजन करय लेल नेपाल के चयन भेल छल। "एही लेली ई कहना गलत छै कि ई आयोजन के योजना हाल ही म॑ ही बनलऽ छेलै । ई फैसला चारि साल पहलें ही लेलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, आरू पेकिंग विश्वविद्यालय सहित चीन केरऽ कई विश्वविद्यालयऽ के एगो बड़ऽ प्रतिनिधिमंडल के भाग लेबै के उम्मीद छेलै।"

लगभग १०० चीनी विद्वान आरू विशेषज्ञ — जेकरा म॑ चीन तिब्बत विज्ञान अनुसंधान केंद्र स॑ भी शामिल छेलै — न॑ ई गोष्ठी म॑ भाग लेबै लेली पंजीकरण करल॑ छेलै, जेकरा म॑ तिब्बती इतिहास, भाषा, संस्कृति, कला, दर्शन आरू धर्म केरऽ विद्वानऽ क॑ एक साथ लानै के छेलै । आयोजक के कहनाय छनि जे ओ बीजिंग के मूल शर्त पर पहिने सं सहमत भ गेल छलाह.

एकटा आओर आयोजक कहलनि जे, हम सब अधिकारि सब के आश्वासन देने छलहुं जे तिब्बत समर्थक या चीन विरोधी कोनो गतिविधि या बयान नहि होयत आ एहन सक्रियता स जुड़ल कोनो व्यक्ति के आमंत्रित नहि कायल जायत, हमरा सब के ई नहि बुझल अछि जे आब सरकार एहि आयोजन के रोकय पर किएक विचार क रहल अछि।

काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय के प्रवक्ता के कहनाय छनि जे संस्था बेर-बेर सरकार के कहलक अछि जे ई सम्मेलन “विशुद्ध रूप सं शैक्षणिक अभ्यास” अछि जाहि मे कोनो तिब्बत समर्थक या चीन विरोधी एजेंडा नहि अछि.

प्रवक्ता कहलनि जे, हमरा सब पर आयोजन रद्द करबाक अपार दबाव बनल अछि। एकरऽ बाद काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय न॑ संयोजक के रूप म॑ वापसी करी लेल॑ छै, जेकरा स॑ ई तय करै के जिम्मेदारी इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन फॉर तिब्बती स्टडीज (आईएटीएस) प॑ छोड़ी देलऽ गेलऽ छै कि ई गोष्ठी अखनी भी आयोजित करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै कि नै — आरू कतय — ।

एक आयोजक न॑ बीजिंग केरऽ अलार्म क॑ एगो अलग फ्लैशपॉइंट स॑ जोड़लकै: चीन केरऽ नया जातीय एकता कानून के खिलाफ तिब्बती लोगऽ के विरोध, जे १ जुलाई स॑ लागू होय गेलै ।एमनेस्टी इंटरनेशनल के अनुसार ई कानून चीनी कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी केरऽ राजनीतिक एजेंडा क॑ आगू बढ़ाबै के पूर्व शर्त के रूप म॑ “जातीय एकता” के रूपरेखा तैयार करै छै, जेकरा म॑ शी जिनपिंग थॉट भी शामिल छै । “चीन केरऽ नया जातीय एकता कानून के खिलाफ बड़ऽ विरोध होय चुकलऽ छै । यही लेली बीजिंग न॑ अपनऽ पैरवी तेज करी क॑ काठमांडू म॑ कोनो भी अप्रिय घटना क॑ रोकै लेली अपनऽ प्रभाव के इस्तेमाल करलकै ।’’ आयोजक न॑ कहलकै ।

एहि फैसला स अवगत एकटा उच्च पदस्थ सरकारी अधिकारी पोस्ट कए कहलथि जे सरकार कए गोष्ठी कए एकदम स रद्द करबा स बेसी जोखिम क प्रबंधन पर ध्यान देबाक चाही छल।

रद्द भेलाक बादो गोष्ठी स जुड़ल चीनी प्रतिनिधिमंडल एखनो नेपाल पहुंचबाक उम्मीद अछि। जियांग जियांगुओ — सीपीपीसीसी केरऽ राष्ट्रीय समिति केरऽ स्थायी समिति के सदस्य, ओकरऽ जातीय आरू धार्मिक समिति केरऽ उपनिदेशक, आरू चीन सोसाइटी फॉर ह्यूमन राइट्स स्टडीज केरऽ कार्यकारी उपाध्यक्ष — के साथ पांच लोगऽ के प्रतिनिधिमंडल भी आबै वाला छै, जे 18 अगस्त क॑ तीन दिन के यात्रा लेली पहुँचतै ।

काठमांडू मे चीनी दूतावास पोस्ट के बेर-बेर टिप्पणी करय के आग्रह के जवाब नहि देलक.

आयोजन केरऽ मुख्य संयोजकऽ म॑ स॑ एक प्रोफेसर सागर शर्मा न॑ कहलकै कि चूँकि हम्मं॑ संयोजक के रूप म॑ वापसी करी लेल॑ छियै, ई लेली अब॑ ई तय करना आईएटीएस प॑ छै कि ई कार्यक्रम कत॑ आरू कोना आयोजित करलऽ जैतै ।

title: Restaurant Featuring The Food of Nepal Proposed For Plaza In Vernon - Patch

full_article:
The Vernon Planning and Zoning Commission Tuesday continued its review of a proposed Nepali restaurant at 1189 Hartford Turnpike. The site plan will be examined again on Aug. 18, Vernon Director of Development Services Shaun Gately said.

The restaurant has been proposed for the strip plaza at 1189 Hartford Turnpike and fills a vacancy of more than four years. It had previously been a former Cape Cod style house converted into the Wine Seller Liquor store, but the business was renamed Discount Wine & Liquors Shop when it moved into a completely renovated and expanded plaza in Nov. 2021.

title: Nepal’s federal security gap: Provinces have constitutional authority, CDOs exercise real power - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepal’s federal security gap: Provinces have constitutional authority, CDOs exercise real power  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Last week, as tensions grew in Kaptanganj of Dewanganj Rural Municipality after a minor dispute between Hindu and Muslim youths escalated, the security situation began to deteriorate.



At the centre of decision-making was one person — the Chief District Officer (CDO) of Sunsari. The deployment of the Nepal Police and the Armed Police Force, the imposition of curfew, and decisions that could eventually require the presence of the Nepali Army all rested with him.



The CDO chaired meetings with political party leaders, protesting youths, federal lawmakers, and local representatives from the affected areas.



Meanwhile, in Biratnagar, about 15 kilometres from Kaptanganj, Morang’s CDO declared a curfew in parts of the district and banned loud religious music and sermons. The objective was to prevent a repeat of what was unfolding in the neighbouring district.



Such decisions by CDOs were not limited to Sunsari and Morang districts of Koshi province. As protests and violence spread, CDOs in Dhanusha and Siraha of Madhesh Province adopted similar measures.



What these CDOs did was part of a long-established process in Nepal’s security governance. The contradiction, however, is that these decisions continue to be taken under an old legal framework — the Local Administration Act, 1971, which predates Nepal’s federal constitution. The Constitution of Nepal, 2015, does not recognise districts as administrative units. Thus CDOs have no place in the security structure.



The constitution places “provincial police administration and peace and security” under the exclusive authority of provinces. Yet when the crisis unfolded in Sunsari, the Chief Minister’s Office of Koshi Province and provincial ministers were holding routine formal meetings. The situation was similar in Madhesh Province.



All provinces have their own Ministry of Internal Affairs, similar in function to the federal Ministry of Home Affairs. But despite being responsible for peace and security under the constitution, these ministries remain largely disconnected from security decisions in their districts because CDOs do not report to them.



Appointed by the federal government in Kathmandu, CDOs are answerable to the Ministry of Home Affairs. In practice, provincial internal affairs ministries do not recognise CDOs as officials under their command, and CDOs do not consider themselves accountable to provincial governments.



Province-level political leaders and analysts argue that, in security governance, Nepal’s federal system remains far from functional. According to them, continued federal control through CDOs has weakened the security role assigned to provinces by the constitution and complicated crisis management.



“Just as the Rana rulers used to appoint Patwaris and Ditthas (handpicked local officials), the federal government is now continuing to send CDOs,” said Kedar Karki, former Koshi internal affairs minister and former chief minister. “Peace and security is the most important authority of the provincial government. But in practice, the CDO has become more powerful than the provincial government.”



The underlying issue, according to critics, is that the federal transition has remained incomplete. Nearly a decade after the promulgation of the constitution, the federal government has still not enacted all the laws necessary to make provincial powers operational. The constitution envisioned that many laws required to implement federalism would later be enacted by the federal parliament, but that process remains unfinished.



Federalism is often described as becoming meaningful only when provincial governments possess the “gun, pen, and money.” The phrase is a metaphor for three essential dimensions of provincial autonomy. The gun represents the authority to maintain law and order and enforce decisions through institutions such as a provincial police force. The pen represents the power to legislate on matters assigned to provinces, allowing them to create policies suited to local needs. The money represents the fiscal resources and financial autonomy required to implement those responsibilities.



Nepal’s provinces have gained some authority over the latter two, but policing — the most visible symbol of state authority — has remained largely under federal control.



According to Indramani Parajuli, Koshi Province’s Minister for Internal Affairs and Law, the provincial government is currently limited mostly to coordination and support functions.



“At present, we are working more on the management and coordination side. For example, if relief or rescue work is required somewhere,” Parajuli said. “The provincial police have not been adjusted into the federal structure. In terms of the core spirit and pace of federalism, the important responsibility of maintaining peace and security has not been given to provincial governments.”



The “core spirit of federalism” referred to by Parajuli goes beyond administrative arrangements. It is linked to the fundamental question of why federalism was introduced in Nepal in the first place.



Renu Chand, a former Constituent Assembly member from the then CPN (Maoist) and currently a National Assembly member, says the debate on federalism in Nepal did not emerge from a desire for administrative decentralisation or merely from aspirations for development.





But in practice, she says, everyday security administration continues to operate through the old legal framework.





Sunsari CDO Ishwari Prasad Aryal, however, insists that the command structure for security management is clear and that the existing system provides an effective mechanism for responding to crises.



“Whenever a security crisis occurs in the district, leadership comes from the District Security Committee. The CDO chairs the committee. The Nepal Police, Armed Police Force, National Investigation Department, and local offices of the Nepali Army, among other security agencies, work under this structure,” Aryal told Kantipur. “All matters related to peace and security within the district are handled by this committee under the leadership of the CDO.”



Aryal said that although it is not mandatory under the current law, CDOs continue to inform provincial Ministries of Internal Affairs about security matters.

Morang Chief District Officer Yubaraj Kattel is even more assertive about the authority of CDOs.



“Everything can be done by the CDO,” he said. “Within the current structure, defined by the Local Administration Act, 1971, lies the authority to assess situations, decide whether prohibitory orders or curfews are necessary, request additional forces, and coordinate with the Home Ministry.”



According to Kattel, the law does not even require a CDO to consult the Home Ministry before imposing a curfew.



This is the central contradiction: CDOs say they are operating within the legal framework that exists, while provincial leaders argue that the same framework allows an administrative structure to operate alongside — and above — the constitutional one.



Santosh Pokharel, principal of Adarsha Secondary School in Biratnagar, says the problem began because the federal transition was not accompanied by the necessary laws.





“The constitution guaranteed the rights, but the necessary laws were not enacted. Because the federal government did not make the laws, the provinces could not create and implement them on their own,” he said.



The question of command and control has also drawn attention from security officials, who have at times suggested the need for better coordination between lower-level institutions — provinces and districts. After the Sunsari incident, at a meeting of the Central Security Committee in Kathmandu the following day, security chiefs urged the home minister that lower-level agencies should be guided through coordination rather than receiving strategic instructions on every matter.



However, for the federal Home Ministry, the effective lower-level authority continues to be the CDO leaving the provincial government with limited influence over security decisions.



Biratnagar-based local governance expert Arjun Bishwakarma says that if provincial governments had real authority, they could respond more quickly to incidents such as the one in Sunsari.



“The federal home minister arrived at the scene only on the fifth day after national pressure mounted. A provincial government would not have taken that long,” he said.





According to Bishwakarma, accountability can only exist when authority exists.



“In what happened in Kaptanganj, one could have asked the provincial government, ministers, and other officials why they were not responsible. But that path does not exist right now,” he told Kantipur.





The police operating under the CDOs also understand the command structure according to the framework established by the Local Administration Act, 1971.



SSP Yogendra Singh Thapa, spokesperson of the Koshi Provincial Police Office — which itself carries the word “provincial” in its name — says security management at the district level remains under the authority of the CDO.



“Security management in the district takes place under the Chief District Officer,” he says. “The Local Administration Act has given the CDO full responsibility for issuing prohibitory orders and imposing curfews. The district where an incident occurs is the first to respond.”

For provincial governments, however, the problem is that they carry constitutional responsibility without corresponding authority.



What consequences does this contradiction create?



“The security agency is more accountable to the institution that gives instructions and deploys it. It follows whatever policy and direction comes from above,” said Parajuli. “We are in a situation where whatever results we achieve depend on how much we can work through personal relationships.”



Morang CDO Kattel describes the limitation of such informal arrangements more directly.



“The Local Administration Act does not recognise the province,” he said.



Security committees have also been created at the provincial level through directives from the Home Ministry. The CDO of the district where the provincial capital is located serves as a member of such committees. As a result, Kattel is technically a member of the Koshi Province Security Committee, but he says the arrangement has little practical significance.



“Our law does not recognise that committee. We are not legally required to follow its instructions,” he says.



Kattel says the information he occasionally provides to the province is not a legal obligation but rather an act of goodwill.



“When we send reports to the Home Ministry’s control room in the evening, we also send a copy to the province. But that is not mandatory. There is no legal obligation towards the province at all,” he said. “Sometimes we even forget to inform them, because there is no system. There is no link. So it is not really something that remains in our minds.”



The problem extends beyond information sharing. It also affects police mobilisation and accountability.



A significant portion of the performance evaluation of district police chiefs is conducted by the CDO. The performance evaluation of provincial police is done by the provincial chief secretary. However, the chief secretary is a federal civil servant, and transfers and promotions remain controlled by Kathmandu.



“A federal government joint secretary is more powerful here than our provincial chief secretary,” Karki says. “With a single letter or phone call, he can halt the province’s work or transfer the chief secretary. That is why officials who come here always remain loyal to the federal government.”



The question of who gave orders and how the security response unfolded after the Kaptanganj incident is therefore not only about one district. It reflects how Nepal’s security system continues to operate during crises.



Whenever a security crisis occurs, the CDO takes command. The CDO mobilises the Nepal Police and Armed Police Force. If necessary, the security committee decides on the deployment of the Nepali Army. The provincial government is limited to a “coordination” role, which provincial leaders argue amounts to having responsibility without authority, while the Home Ministry issues directives.



But the question remains: Is this the arrangement envisioned by the constitution?



The Koshi provincial government says — No. The constitution has assigned us that authority.



The CDOs say — We are working according to the law.



The police say — We are operating according to the legal structure that exists.



Political leaders and analysts say — The problem is not in the constitution, but in its implementation.
translated:
पिछला सप्ताह देवांगंज ग्रामीण नगरपालिका के कप्तानगंज में हिन्दू आ मुस्लिम युवा सब के बीच छोट विवाद बढ़ला के बाद तनाव बढ़ला पर सुरक्षा के स्थिति बिगड़य लागल।



निर्णय लेबऽ के केंद्र में एक व्यक्ति छेलै — सुनसरी के मुख्य जिला अधिकारी (सीडीओ) । नेपाल प्रहरी आ सशस्त्र प्रहरी बलक तैनाती, कर्फ्यू लगाबय, आ निर्णय जे अंततः नेपाली सेनाक उपस्थितिक आवश्यकता भऽ सकैत अछि, सब किछु हुनका पर टिकल छल ।



सीडीओ के अध्यक्षता में राजनीतिक दल के नेता, विरोध प्रदर्शन करय वाला युवा, संघीय विधायक, आ प्रभावित क्षेत्र के स्थानीय प्रतिनिधि के संग बैसार भेल.



एम्हर, कप्तानगंज सं करीब 15 किलोमीटर दूर विराटनगर मे मोरंग के सीडीओ जिला के किछ हिस्सा मे कर्फ्यू के घोषणा करैत जोर-जोर सं धार्मिक संगीत आओर प्रवचन पर रोक लगा देलखिन्ह. उद्देश्य छल जे पड़ोसी जिला मे जे किछु खुलि रहल छल ओकर दोहराव नहि हो।



सीडीओ क एहन फैसला कोशी प्रांत क सुनसरी आ मोरंग जिला तक सीमित नहि छल। विरोध आ हिंसा पसरला पर मधेश प्रदेश के धनुषा आ सिरहा मे सीडीओ सेहो एहने उपाय अपनाओल गेल।



ई सीडीओ सब जे केलक से नेपाल के सुरक्षा शासन में बहुत दिन स स्थापित प्रक्रिया के हिस्सा छल। लेकिन एकरऽ विरोधाभास ई छै कि ई फैसला एगो पुरानऽ कानूनी ढाँचा के तहत जारी छै — स्थानीय प्रशासन अधिनियम, १९७१, जे नेपाल केरऽ संघीय संविधान स॑ पूर्व केरऽ छै । नेपालक संविधान, २०१५ मे जिला सभ केँ प्रशासनिक इकाईक रूप मे मान्यता नहि देल गेल अछि । एहि तरहें सुरक्षा संरचना मे सीडीओ क कोनो स्थान नहि अछि।



संविधान “प्रांतीय पुलिस प्रशासन आ शांति आ सुरक्षा” के प्रांत के विशेष अधिकार के तहत रखैत अछि | तइयो जखन सुनसरी मे संकट के खुलासा भेल त कोशी प्रांत के मुख्यमंत्री कार्यालय आओर प्रांतीय मंत्री सब के नियमित औपचारिक बैसार भ रहल छल. मधेश प्रदेश मे सेहो एहने स्थिति छल ।



सब प्रांत केरऽ अपनऽ आतंरिक मंत्रालय छै, जेकरऽ कार्य संघीय गृह मंत्रालय केरऽ समान छै । लेकिन संविधान के तहत शांति आरू सुरक्षा के जिम्मेदार होय के बावजूद ई मंत्रालय सब अपनौ जिला मँ सुरक्षा के फैसला स॑ काफी हद तलक विच्छेदित छै, कैन्हेंकि सीडीओ ओकरा रिपोर्ट नै करै छै ।



काठमांडूमे संघीय सरकार द्वारा नियुक्त सीडीओ गृहमन्त्रालयके उत्तरदायी होइत अछि । व्यवहार मे प्रांतीय आंतरिक मामलों मंत्रालय सीडीओ कें अपन कमान मे अधिकारी कें रूप मे मान्यता नहि देयत छै, आ सीडीओ प्रांतीय सरकारक कें सामने खुद कें जवाबदेह नहि मानयत छै.



प्रांत स्तरीय राजनीतिक नेता आ विश्लेषक लोकनिक तर्क छनि जे, सुरक्षा शासन मे नेपालक संघीय व्यवस्था काज करबा सँ बहुत दूर अछि । हुनका सब के अनुसार सीडीओ के माध्यम स संघीय नियंत्रण जारी रहला स संविधान द्वारा प्रांत सब के देल गेल सुरक्षा भूमिका कमजोर भ गेल अछि आ संकट प्रबंधन जटिल भ गेल अछि।



कोशी के पूर्व आतंरिक मंत्री आ पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री केदार कार्की कहलनि जे, जेना राणा के शासक पटवारी आ दिट्ठा (हस्त चुनल स्थानीय अधिकारी) के नियुक्ति करैत छल, तहिना संघीय सरकार आब सीडीओ भेजब जारी रखने अछि। “शान्ति आ सुरक्षा प्रांतीय सरकारक सबसँ महत्वपूर्ण अधिकार अछि।मुदा व्यवहार मे सीडीओ प्रांतीय सरकार सँ बेसी शक्तिशाली भ’ गेल अछि।”



आलोचकऽ के अनुसार एकरऽ अंतर्निहित मुद्दा ई छै कि संघीय संक्रमण अधूरा रहलऽ छै । संविधान जारी भेलाक करीब एक दशक बाद सेहो संघीय सरकार प्रांतीय अधिकार कए परिचालन मे आबय लेल आवश्यक सबटा कानून नहि बनौलक अछि । संविधान मे परिकल्पना छल जे संघीयता लागू करबाक लेल आवश्यक बहुत रास कानून बाद मे संघीय संसद द्वारा बनाओल जायत, मुदा ओ प्रक्रिया अधूरा अछि ।



संघवाद केरऽ वर्णन अक्सर तखनी करलऽ जाय छै जब॑ प्रांतीय सरकारऽ के पास “बन्दूक, कलम, आरू पैसा” होय छै । ई वाक्यांश प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता के तीन आवश्यक आयाम के रूपक छै । बंदूक प्रांतीय पुलिस बल जैसनऽ संस्था के माध्यम स॑ कानून व्यवस्था क॑ कायम रखै आरू फैसला लागू करै के अधिकार के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छै । कलम प्रांतक कें सौंपल गेल मामलाक पर कानून बनावा कें शक्ति कें प्रतिनिधित्व करयत छै, जेकरा सं ओकरा स्थानीय जरूरतक कें अनुकूल नीति बनावा कें अनुमति मिलयत छै. इ पैसा ओय जिम्मेदारियक कें लागू करय कें लेल आवश्यक राजकोषीय संसाधन आ वित्तीय स्वायत्तता कें प्रतिनिधित्व करय छै.



नेपाल केरऽ प्रांतऽ क॑ बाद केरऽ दू प्रांत प॑ कुछ अधिकार मिललऽ छै, लेकिन पुलिसिंग — राज्य केरऽ अधिकार केरऽ सबसें दिखाई दै वाला प्रतीक — काफी हद तलक संघीय नियंत्रण म॑ रहलऽ छै ।



कोशी प्रांत केरऽ आतंरिक मामिला आरू कानून मंत्री इंद्रमणि पराजुली के अनुसार प्रांतीय सरकार अभी अधिकतर समन्वय आरू सहायता कार्य तक सीमित छै ।



पराजुली कहलनि जे, वर्तमान मे हम सब प्रबंधन आ समन्वय पक्ष पर बेसी काज क रहल छी, जेना कि अगर कतहु राहत या बचाव के काज के जरूरत होयत त। ओ कहलनि जे, प्रांतीय पुलिस के संघीय संरचना मे समायोजित नहि कायल गेल अछि। संघीयता के मूल भावना आ गति के मामला में शांति आ सुरक्षा के कायम रखबाक महत्वपूर्ण जिम्मेदारी प्रांतीय सरकार के नै देल गेल अछि।”



पराजुली द्वारा उल्लेखित “संघवाद के मूल भावना” प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था स आगू बढ़ैत अछि । ई मौलिक प्रश्न सँ जुड़ल अछि जे नेपाल मे संघीयताक प्रचलन पहिल बेर किएक भेल ।



तत्कालीन नेकपा (माओवादी) के संविधानसभा सदस्य रहल आ वर्तमान मे राष्ट्रीय सभा सदस्य रेणु चंद के कहनाय छनि जे नेपाल मे संघीयता पर बहस प्रशासनिक विकेंद्रीकरण के इच्छा स नहि या मात्र विकास के आकांक्षा स नहि निकलल छल।





लेकिन व्यवहार म॑ हुनकऽ कहना छै कि रोजमर्रा के सुरक्षा प्रशासन पुरानऽ कानूनी ढाँचा के माध्यम स॑ काम जारी छै ।





सुनसरी केरऽ सीडीओ ईश्वरी प्रसाद अर्यल केरऽ कहना छै कि सुरक्षा प्रबंधन लेली कमांड स्ट्रक्चर साफ छै आरू मौजूदा सिस्टम संकटऽ के जवाब दै लेली एगो प्रभावी तंत्र उपलब्ध करै छै ।



ओ कहला जे जिला मे जखन कखनो सुरक्षा संकट अबैत अछि त नेतृत्व जिला सुरक्षा समिति स अबैत अछि। समितिक अध्यक्षता सीडीओ करैत छथि। नेपाल प्रहरी, सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल, राष्ट्रिय अनुसन्धान विभाग, आ नेपाली सेनाके स्थानीय कार्यालय सहित अन्य सुरक्षा एजेन्सी अहि संरचनाके अन्तर्गत कार्य करैत अछि ।’ अर्यल कान्तिपुरमे कहलनि ।



अर्यल नँ कहलकै कि हालांकि वर्तमान कानून के तहत ई अनिवार्य नै छै, लेकिन सीडीओ सुरक्षा मामला के बारे मँ प्रांतीय आतंरिक मंत्रालय क जानकारी दै के काम जारी रखै छै ।

मोरंग के मुख्य जिला अधिकारी युबराज कट्टल सीडीओ के अधिकार के ल क आओर बेसी आग्रही छथिन्ह.



ओ कहला जे सब किछु सीडीओ क सकैत अछि। “स्थानीय प्रशासन अधिनियम, 1971 द्वारा परिभाषित वर्तमान संरचना के भीतर परिस्थिति के आकलन करै के अधिकार छै, ई तय करै के कि निषेधात्मक आदेश या कर्फ्यू जरूरी छै कि नै, अतिरिक्त बल के अनुरोध करै के, आरू गृह मंत्रालय के साथ समन्वय करै के अधिकार छै।”



कटेल के अनुसार कानून के अनुसार कर्फ्यू लगाबय सं पहिने सीडीओ के गृह मंत्रालय सं सलाह लेबय के जरूरत तक नहिं अछि.



ई केंद्रीय विरोधाभास छै: सीडीओ के कहना छै कि वू कानूनी ढाँचा के भीतर संचालित छै जे मौजूद छै, जबकि प्रांतीय नेता सिनी के तर्क छै कि वही ढाँचा संवैधानिक संरचना के साथ-साथ — आरू ओकरा स॑ ऊपर — प्रशासनिक संरचना क॑ संचालित करै के अनुमति दै छै ।



विराटनगर के आदर्श माध्यमिक विद्यालय के प्राचार्य संतोष पोखरेल के कहनाय छनि जे संघीय संक्रमण के संग जरूरी कानून के संग नहि चलय के कारण समस्या शुरू भेल छल.





ओ कहलनि जे, संविधान अधिकारक गारंटी देलक, मुदा आवश्यक कानून नहि बनल। संघीय सरकार कानून नहि बनौलकाक कारण प्रान्त सब अपनहि बनाबय आ लागू नहि क सकल।'



कमान आरू नियंत्रण के सवाल सुरक्षा अधिकारी सिनी के भी ध्यान आकर्षित करलकै, जेकरा नँ कखनी-कखनी निचला स्तर के संस्थान — प्रांत आरू जिला के बीच बेहतर समन्वय के जरूरत के सुझाव देल॑ छै । सुनसरी घटना के बाद अगिला दिन काठमांडू मे केन्द्रीय सुरक्षा समिति के बैसार मे सुरक्षा प्रमुख सब गृहमंत्री स आग्रह केलनि जे निचला स्तर के एजेंसी के हर मामला पर रणनीतिक निर्देश प्राप्त करय के बजाय समन्वय के माध्यम सं मार्गदर्शन करबाक चाही.



लेकिन संघीय गृह मंत्रालय के लेलऽ प्रभावी निचला स्तर के प्राधिकारी सीडीओ बनलऽ छै जेकरा स॑ प्रांतीय सरकार क॑ सुरक्षा फैसला प॑ सीमित प्रभाव छोड़ी देलऽ जाय छै ।



विराटनगर के स्थानीय शासन विशेषज्ञ अर्जुन विश्वकर्मा के कहनाय छनि जे अगर प्रांतीय सरकार के वास्तविक अधिकार रहैत त सुनसरी के जेना घटना पर ओ बेसी जल्दी जवाब द सकैत छल.



ओ कहलनि जे, राष्ट्रीय दबाव बढ़लाक बाद मात्र पांचम दिन संघीय गृहमंत्री मौका पर पहुंचल छलाह। प्रांतीय सरकार मे एतेक समय नहि लागैत।'





विश्वकर्मा के अनुसार जवाबदेही तखने भ सकैत अछि जखन अधिकार हो।



ओ कहला जे कप्तानगंज मे जे भेल ओहि मे प्रांतीय सरकार, मंत्री, आ अन्य अधिकारी स पूछल जा सकैत छल जे ओ सब जिम्मेदार किएक नहि छथि। मुदा ओ बाट एखन नहि अछि।'





सीडीओ के तहत संचालित पुलिस सेहो स्थानीय प्रशासन अधिनियम, 1971 द्वारा स्थापित ढाँचा के अनुसार कमांड संरचना के समझैत अछि.



कोशी प्रांतीय प्रहरी कार्यालय के प्रवक्ता एसएसपी योगेन्द्र सिंह थापा – जे खुद नाम में “प्रांतीय” शब्द के वाहक छै – के कहना छै कि जिला स्तर पर सुरक्षा प्रबंधन सीडीओ के अधिकार में बनल छै ।



ओ कहैत छथि जे जिला मे सुरक्षा प्रबंधन मुख्य जिला अधिकारी क तहत होइत अछि। ओ कहला जे स्थानीय प्रशासन अधिनियम मे सीडीओ कए निषेधात्मक आदेश जारी करबाक आ कर्फ्यू लगेबाक पूरा जिम्मेदारी देल गेल अछि। जाहि जिला मे कोनो घटना घटित होइत छैक, ओहि जिला मे सबसँ पहिने एकर जवाब भेटैत छैक।”

प्रांतीय सरकार के लेलऽ लेकिन समस्या ई छै कि वू बिना तदनुरूप अधिकार के संवैधानिक जिम्मेदारी उठाबै छै ।



ई विरोधाभास की परिणाम उत्पन्न करैत अछि ?



ओ कहला जे सुरक्षा एजेंसी ओहि संस्था क प्रति बेसी जवाबदेह अछि जे निर्देश दैत अछि आ ओकरा तैनात करैत अछि। ऊपर स॑ जे भी नीति आरू दिशा आबै छै ओकरऽ पालन करै छै ।’’ पराजुली न॑ कहलकै कि हम्में ऐन्हऽ स्थिति म॑ छियै कि हम्में जे भी परिणाम प्राप्त करबै, ई ई बात प॑ निर्भर करै छै कि हम्मं॑ व्यक्तिगत संबंधऽ के माध्यम स॑ कतेक काम करी सकै छियै ।



मोरंग के सीडीओ कटेल एहन अनौपचारिक व्यवस्था के सीमा के बेसी सीधा वर्णन करैत छथि ।



ओ कहलनि जे, स्थानीय प्रशासन अधिनियम मे प्रांत के मान्यता नहि देल गेल अछि।



गृह मंत्रालय के निर्देश के माध्यम सं प्रांतीय स्तर पर सुरक्षा समिति सेहो बनाओल गेल अछि. प्रांतीय राजधानी जतय अछि ओहि जिलाक सीडीओ एहन समितिक सदस्यक काज करैत अछि । एकरऽ परिणाम ई छै कि कटेल तकनीकी रूप स॑ कोशी प्रांत सुरक्षा समिति के सदस्य छै, लेकिन हुनकऽ कहना छै कि ई व्यवस्था केरऽ व्यावहारिक महत्व बहुत कम छै ।



ओ कहला जे हमर कानून ओहि समिति कए मान्यता नहि दैत अछि। हमरा सब कए कानूनी तौर पर एकर निर्देश क पालन करब जरूरी नहि अछि।Ó ओ कहैत छथि।



कटेल के कहनाय छनि जे ओ यदा-कदा प्रांत के जे जानकारी दैत छथिन्ह ओ कानूनी दायित्व नहिं बल्कि सद्भावना के काज अछि.



ओ कहला जे जखन हम सांझ मे गृह मंत्रालय क कंट्रोल रूम मे रिपोर्ट पठाबैत छी त एकर कॉपी सेहो प्रांत मे पठा दैत छी। मुदा से अनिवार्य नहि। प्रांत के प्रति कोनो कानूनी दायित्व बिल्कुल नै छै।' कोनो कड़ी नहि अछि। तेँ ई वास्तव मे एहन बात नहि अछि जे हमरा सभक मोन मे रहैत अछि।”



समस्या सूचना साझा करय सं आगू बढ़ि गेल अछि. एकरऽ असर पुलिस जुटान आरू जवाबदेही प॑ भी पड़ै छै ।



जिला थानाध्यक्ष क प्रदर्शन मूल्यांकन क एकटा महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा सीडीओ द्वारा कैल जाइत अछि। प्रांतीय पुलिस के प्रदर्शन मूल्यांकन प्रांतीय मुख्य सचिव द्वारा कयल जाइत अछि | मुदा, मुख्य सचिव संघीय सिविल सेवक छथि, आ स्थानांतरण आ पदोन्नति पर काठमांडू के नियंत्रण बनल अछि ।



कार्की कहैत छथि जे एहि ठाम संघीय सरकार क संयुक्त सचिव हमर प्रांतीय मुख्य सचिव स बेसी शक्तिशाली छथि। “एकटा चिट्ठी या फोन कॉल स ओ प्रांत क काज रोक सकैत छथि या मुख्य सचिव कए स्थानांतरित क सकैत छथि । यैह कारण अछि जे एतय अबैत अधिकारी सभ सदिखन संघीय सरकारक प्रति निष्ठावान रहैत छथि।”



कप्तानगंज घटना के बाद के आदेश देलक आ सुरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया केना खुलल ई सवाल एहि लेल सिर्फ एकटा जिला के नहिं अछि. एहि मे इ दर्शाओल गेल अछि जे संकट के समय मे नेपाल के सुरक्षा व्यवस्था कोना संचालित रहैत अछि.



जखन कखनो सुरक्षा संकट अबैत अछि त सीडीओ कमान संभालैत अछि। सीडीओ नेपाल प्रहरी आ सशस्त्र प्रहरी बलके जुटान करैत अछि । जरुरत पड़ला पर सुरक्षा समिति नेपाली सेनाक तैनाती पर निर्णय लैत अछि । प्रांतीय सरकार “समन्वय” भूमिका तक सीमित छै, जेकरा प्रांतीय नेता सिनी के तर्क छै कि बिना अधिकार के जिम्मेदारी के बराबर छै, जबकि गृह मंत्रालय निर्देश जारी करै छै ।



मुदा सवाल बनल अछि जे की संविधान द्वारा परिकल्पित व्यवस्था इएह अछि?



कोशी प्रांतीय सरकार कहैत अछि — नहि संविधान हमरा सभकेँ ओ अधिकार देने अछि ।



सीडीओ सब कहैत छथि — हम सब कानून के अनुसार काज क रहल छी।



पुलिस कहैत अछि — हम सब कानूनी संरचना के अनुसार संचालित भ रहल छी जे मौजूद अछि ।



राजनीतिक नेता आ विश्लेषक कहैत छथि — समस्या संविधान मे नहि, ओकर क्रियान्वयन मे अछि ।

title: Nepal cancels international Tibetan studies conference following Chinese pressure - Phayul

full_article:
Tenzin Nyidon

DHARAMSHALA, Aug. 5: The Government of Nepal has cancelled the 17th Seminar of the International Association for Tibetan Studies (IATS), an internationally renowned academic conference that was scheduled to take place in Kathmandu from August 23 to 29, 2026.

The decision was communicated personally by Nepal’s Chief Secretary, Govinda Bahadur Karkee, following consultations with Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai. According to organizers, senior officials at Kathmandu University were instructed not to proceed with hosting the conference, bringing an abrupt end to nearly four years of planning for what was expected to be one of the largest gatherings of Tibet scholars in recent years.

The cancellation follows sustained diplomatic pressure from the Chinese Embassy in Kathmandu. Chinese Ambassador Zhang Maoming is reported to have repeatedly raised concerns with Nepali authorities, arguing that the conference could become a platform for discussions or statements that Beijing considers politically sensitive, particularly those related to Tibet and His Holiness the Dalai Lama.

A Tibetan researcher told Phayul that even before the government’s decision, the conference had already become the focus of mounting political pressure. The venue, Hotel Soaltee in Kathmandu, has long hosted visiting Chinese state delegations, including Chinese President Xi Jinping during his 2019 visit to Nepal. As diplomatic pressure from Beijing intensified, exile Tibetan scholars and researchers increasingly found themselves sidelined from the event.

In contrast, Chinese state-affiliated institutions, including the China Tibetology Research Center, had registered a delegation of nearly 100 participants, a move that observers viewed as an effort to shape academic discourse on Tibet during the conference.

The seminar was jointly organized by the Kathmandu University Himalaya Centre for Asian Studies (KU HiCAS) and the Rangjung Yeshe Institute. Organizers said the university is awaiting formal written notification from the government but confirmed that KU HiCAS and the Kathmandu University Centre for Buddhist Studies (KU-CBS) will not proceed with convening the conference. Any further decisions regarding the event will be taken by the IATS Executive Committee.

The cancellation has drawn disappointment from organizers and scholars, who stressed that IATS is a scholarly forum dedicated to academic research. This intervention has intensified concerns over Beijing’s growing influence in Kathmandu, with observers viewing it as part of China’s broader effort to shape international discourse on Tibet, consistent with the objectives of its “Ethnic Unity and Progress Law.”

तेन्जिन न्यिडोन

धर्मशाला, ५ अगस्त : नेपाल सरकार अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय ख्याति प्राप्त शैक्षणिक सम्मेलन अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय तिब्बती अध्ययन संघ (आईएटीएस)के १७म गोष्ठी रद्द कएने अछि जे २३ सँ २९ अगस्त २०२६ धरि काठमांडू मे होबय बला छल ।

विदेश सचिव अमृत बहादुर राय सँ परामर्श केलाक बाद नेपालक मुख्य सचिव गोविन्द बहादुर कार्की व्यक्तिगत रूप सँ ई निर्णय देलनि । आयोजकऽ के अनुसार काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय केरऽ वरिष्ठ अधिकारी सिनी क॑ ई सम्मेलन के आयोजन के साथ आगू नै बढ़ै के निर्देश देलऽ गेलै, जेकरा स॑ लगभग चार साल के योजना के अचानक अंत होय गेलै, जेकरा स॑ हाल के सालऽ म॑ तिब्बत विद्वानऽ के सबस॑ बड़ऽ सभा म॑ स॑ एक होय के उम्मीद छेलै ।

काठमांडू मे चीनी दूतावास के लगातार कूटनीतिक दबाव के बाद ई रद्द करल गेल अछि. खबर छै कि चीन केरऽ राजदूत झांग माओमिंग न॑ बार-बार नेपाली अधिकारियऽ स॑ चिंता व्यक्त करल॑ छै, जेकरऽ तर्क छै कि ई सम्मेलन चर्चा या बयान के मंच बनी सकै छै जेकरा बीजिंग राजनीतिक रूप स॑ संवेदनशील मान॑ छै, खास करी क॑ तिब्बत आरू परम पूज्य दलाई लामा स॑ जुड़लऽ बयान ।

एक तिब्बती शोधकर्ता न॑ फायुल क॑ बतैलकै कि सरकार केरऽ फैसला स॑ पहल॑ ही ई सम्मेलन बढ़त॑ जाय रहलऽ राजनीतिक दबाव के केंद्र बनी चुकलऽ छै । काठमांडू स्थित होटल सोलटी स्थित ई स्थल बहुत दिन सँ चीन के राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग सहित २०१९ के नेपाल यात्रा के दौरान आगंतुक चीन के राज्य प्रतिनिधिमंडल के मेजबानी करैत आबि रहल अछि । जेना-जेना बीजिंग केरऽ कूटनीतिक दबाव तेज होय गेलै, निर्वासित तिब्बती विद्वान आरू शोधकर्ता तेजी स॑ खुद क॑ ई आयोजन स॑ किनारा पाबी गेलै ।

एकरऽ विपरीत चीन तिब्बत विज्ञान अनुसंधान केंद्र सहित चीनी राज्य स॑ जुड़लऽ संस्थान न॑ लगभग १०० प्रतिभागी के प्रतिनिधिमंडल के पंजीकरण करल॑ छेलै, जेकरा पर्यवेक्षक न॑ सम्मेलन के दौरान तिब्बत प॑ शैक्षणिक प्रवचन क॑ आकार दै के प्रयास के रूप म॑ देखलकै ।

काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय हिमालय एशियन स्टडीज केन्द्र (केयू हिकास) आ रंगजंग येशे संस्थान के संयुक्त आयोजन मे ई संगोष्ठी के आयोजन कएल गेल अछि । आयोजक सब कहलनि जे, विश्वविद्यालय सरकार दिस सं औपचारिक लिखित अधिसूचना के इंतजार क रहल अछि, मुदा केयू हाइकास आ काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय बौद्ध अध्ययन केन्द्र (केयू-सीबीएस) सम्मेलन के आह्वान के काज आगू नहि बढ़त से पुष्टि केलनि। एहि आयोजन क संबंध मे आओर कोनो फैसला आईएटीएस क कार्यकारी समिति द्वारा लेल जाएत।

रद्द करला स॑ आयोजक आरू विद्वानऽ के निराशा पैदा होय गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ ई बात प॑ जोर देलऽ गेलऽ छै कि आईएटीएस अकादमिक शोध लेली समर्पित एगो विद्वान मंच छेकै । ई हस्तक्षेप न॑ काठमांडू म॑ बीजिंग केरऽ बढ़तऽ प्रभाव प॑ चिंता क॑ तेज करी देल॑ छै, जेकरा म॑ पर्यवेक्षक एकरा चीन केरऽ तिब्बत प॑ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रवचन क॑ आकार दै के व्यापक प्रयास के हिस्सा के रूप म॑ देखै छै, जे ओकरऽ “जातीय एकता आरू प्रगति कानून” के उद्देश्य के अनुरूप छै ।
